summary.name: DbGate
summary.one_liner: DbGate is an open-source database client and SQL editor for SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and MongoDB, available for desktop and web.
use_cases: Viewing database schemas as ER diagrams
Managing multiple databases from one client
Querying MongoDB and other NoSQL stores
summary.what_it_does: DbGate is a database client with a built-in SQL editor offering auto-completion and syntax highlighting. It supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server and MongoDB, according to the page description and a user review. Visual tools include an ER diagram viewer and a data grid editor for browsing and changing table data. It also covers importing and exporting data and running scripts. The page describes a tabbed interface with a dark mode, built on Electron.
notable: Open-source and free, per the page
Visual ER diagram viewer and data grid editor
Covers both SQL and NoSQL databases including MongoDB
Built on Electron with a dark mode and tabbed layout
caveats: Advanced enterprise features may require plugins, according to a user review
